THE COLOMBO PORT CITY ECONOMIC COMMISSION ACT, No. 11 OF 2021
Order under Section 53

BY VIRTUE of the powers vested in me by Section 53 of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021, I, Ranil Wickremesinghe, Minister of Investment Promotion, having considered the recommendations of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission and upon the approval of the Cabinet of Ministers, do by this Order specify that-

(a) the Cabinet of Ministers, by its decision No. 24/1304/631/032 dated, July 09, 2024 has approved the designationof the business of the authorised person speciﬁ ed in Schedule I hereto as a Secondary Business of StrategicImportance;
(b) the rationale for considering such business as a Secondary Business of Strategic Importance is as speciﬁ ed inSchedule II hereto;
(c) the exemptions or incentives granted under the enactments shall be as speciﬁ ed in Schedule III hereto; and
(d) the exemptions or incentives granted under the enactments speciﬁ ed shall commence and cease to be operativeon the dates speciﬁ ed in Schedule IV hereto.
RANIL WICKREMESINGHE, Minister of Investment Promotion.
Colombo, July 19, 2024.

SCHEDULE II
Rationale for the consideration of the Secondary Business of Strategic Importance

The objectives of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission, as stipulated in Section 5 of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021, have been considered in designating the business as a second Business of Strategic Importance, in order to ensure the success of establishing the Colombo Port City, having regard to the national interest or the advancement of the national economy as provided for in section 53(5) of the said Act.

HORIZON GROUP USA GLOBAL LLC, incorporated in the USA, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Horizon Group USA Inc. founded in 1912, Horizon Group USA Inc is a leading creator, developer and distributed of Fashion driven products for the Craft and specialty markets. It's diverse product lines include Kids' Arts and Craft Components, Activity Kits, Creativity Toys, Fashion Stationery, Back-to-School Supplies, Pet Accessories, Celebration and Party Supplies, and innovative educational tools such as S.T.E.A.M, an educational approach that uses Science, Technology, Engineering, the Arts and Mathematics as access points for guiding student inquiry, dialogue and critical thinking

with an annual turnover exceeding USD 200 Million, Horizon Group USA Inc, serves a broad customer base, including prominent retail chains such as Target, Walmart, Tesco, and Costco Wholesale, While employing approximately 400 professionals globally.

HORIZON GROUP USA GLOBAL LLC will operate as a Global Shared Service center within the Colombo Port city, providing Finance, planning, marketing backend operations and information technology services to Horizon Group USA Inc's global sourcing activities, employing approximately 31 individuals within the initial 3 years of operation, with an investment commitment of approximately USD 1,200,000 towards operational and capital expenditures during this period.

Further, in the long-term HORIZON GROUP USA GLOBAL LLC may expand its Colombo Port City operations to facilitate possible expansions to the European and Asian Markets developing the Colombo Port City as a central hub for global sourcing activities.
